title: Machine learning identifies alkaline laccases from Lepista nuda
summary: Machine-learning pH-optimum predictors screened metagenomic sequences, and two predicted Lepista nuda laccases were produced and profiled. The authors report LnLccA and LnLccB optimum activity at pH 10 and 9 for substrate 2,6-DMP, respectively, while both had pH 4 optima for ABTS. The substrate-dependent contrast is retained; it is not a general alkaline optimum or industrial demonstration.
ai_technology: Supervised, semi-supervised and unsupervised pH-optimum prediction models
organization: University of Helsinki; KTH Royal Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: Open primary full article reports recombinant LnLccA and LnLccB pH profiles, substrate-specific optima and validation of ML predictions.
evidence.unknown: Prior characterization and novelty of sequence/activity remain open; industrial applicability not demonstrated.
evidence.ai_role: Models trained on curated laccase pH data predicted candidates from metagenomic sequences that were expressed and profiled.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
